name: Tideborn Taleria

abilities.name: Arcing Slash/Arcing Cleave/Soaked Wound
abilities.description: Light attack that deals physical and frost damage to target, applies Soaked Wound (a 7 second frost DoT), and has a large cleave dealing physical damage

abilities.name: Coral Slam/Rising Tide
abilities.description: Heavy Attack dealing very high Physical and Frost Damage. If Rolled it creates a large AOE called Rising Tide under the target that hits 3 times dealing frost damage

abilities.name: Crashing Wave
abilities.description: Taleria plunges her blades into the ground and places wave AOEs down, after a brief delay she pulls the swords up and launches waves in those areas dealing high damage and launching players hit backwards. 1 wave will always be positioned around the person with taunt on Taleria (on hard mode one AOE will be on the tank holding a sea behemoth as well).

abilities.name: Rapid Deluge/Deluge Eruption
abilities.description: Taleria debuffs 5 players (6 on hm) with rapid deluge, There will be bubbles around the players affected and they have 6 seconds to make it into the water and be swimming to prevent Deluge Eruption. If a player does not make it into the water, Deluge Eruption a 19m frost AOE will go off dealing very high damage to them and all surrounding players. Note: The water has slaughterfish dealing ramping damage so you want to get in the water as late as you can if possible.

abilities.name: Summon Bridge/Mage(?)
abilities.description: At 50%, 35%, and 20% Mages are summoned on the sides of the Coral Caldera and Rock Bridges fall from the sky to allow players to go out to them. Each mage applies a different debuff to the group while alive.

dialogue.line: Fleet Queen Taleria "Barging into a lady's private chambers. You are bold."
Fleet Queen Taleria "But I won't be conquered so easily."
Fleet Queen Taleria "Let me show you the power that's going to crush that little flotilla of yours."
<She will dive into the water and transform into Tideborn Taleria.>
Tideborn Taleria "My power is as vast as the sea itself!"
Tideborn Taleria "Throw yourselves at my feet and beg for the privilege to lick my boots. Then, maybe, I'll let you keep your tongues."
Tideborn Taleria "I am the sea and tide! And you are just poor guppies."
Tideborn Taleria "I'll return your bodies to the admiral … at the bottom of the sea."
Tideborn Taleria "You really thought you had me on the run, didn't you? Adorable."
Tideborn Taleria "Clouds gather, tides rise, and your precious flotilla will be dashed against the rocks like children's toys."
Tideborn Taleria "Having a twinge of regret about leaping into the serpent's lair?"
Tideborn Taleria "Oh ho, you are brave. I'll enjoy watching that courage fade."
Tideborn Taleria "You little sand fleas are beginning to irritate me."
Tideborn Taleria "Are you mocking me? I was going to take you prisoner, but now I think I'll grate you to shreds on the reef."
Tideborn Taleria "I'll fly your hides from the yardarms."
Tideborn Taleria "Welcome to your drowning pool!"
Tideborn Taleria "Have at me."
Tideborn Taleria "Sirens! A dirge for these doomed souls!"
Tideborn Taleria "Can you hear the sea beckoning? A sultry, seductive melody."
Tideborn Taleria "Into the drink with you!"
Tideborn Taleria "How do you like the water?"
Tideborn Taleria "Drown."
Tideborn Taleria "Where's my crew? Show them who rules the seas!"

Tideborn Taleria "Now you see how far beneath a queen you are."
Tideborn Taleria "You think you can defeat the sea herself? I will be reborn like a wave …."

summary: Tideborn Taleria is a coral monstrosity that Fleet Queen Taleria turns herself into during the final battle of Dreadsail Reef. You will face her at the bottom of the Coral Caldera.
